title: social-messenger grader report
description: One grading session's machine record (LLP 0201 D3; LLP 0197 rules 4 and 12: severity-bucketed defect list, probe results, and O-dimension scores as schema-valid machine records). Produced by the frozen grader prompt (grader-prompt.md); referenced from the lane run record's grading.graderReportPath. The published companion artifact is the sanitized evidence/action trace; raw grader transcripts are never published.

lane.description: Which lane run this report grades.

wave.description: Wave identity and probe-set custody pins.

probeSetSha256.description: The sha256 committed before the wave's first lane started (probes/rotation-log.md is the custody log).

grader.description: Grader identity and abort accounting per D3.4.

family.description: Grading model family; normally the other scored family than the builder's.

sameFamilyGraded.description: True when this is the abort-fallback regrade by the builder's own family; carried into the record and any publication.

calibrationPassed.description: This family passed the calibration gate (calibration.md) before this wave; an ineligible family's grade is not usable.

sessionOutcome.description: grader-abort = the grader's own environment/tooling failed twice (one re-run allowed); not a lane defect.

contaminated.description: True if excluded builder context (diary, self-scores, transcript) reached the grader; the wave orchestrator reassigns the grade.

assertionManifest.description: Pin of the assertions.json version the results key against.

assertionResults.description: Per-assertion results keyed by stable assertion ID from benchmarks/schema/social-messenger/assertions.json (e.g. 'm1-a01'). Every assertion in the run's scope must appear; assertions of never-attempted milestones record not-run (they still score not-passed in O1's denominator).

result.description: pass/fail from independent execution; not-run when the milestone was never attempted or the assertion's precondition never existed; not-applicable for run-scope exclusions (e.g. a full-only assertion on a reduced run) and M7's conditional regression assertion where no milestone was previously green.

method.description: How the grader verified it. [choreo] assertions are scored from harness recordings/receipts (choreography-artifacts), never re-driven by the grader.

suiteResult.description: What the builder's suite reported for this assertion, when suite-required; divergence between suiteResult and result is evidence for the spot-verification verdict.

evidence.description: Pointer into the sanitized evidence/action trace.

bestOf3Ms.description: For timing-sensitive assertions: the three measurements (ms); the best is judged against the bound.

coverageSpotVerification.description: Spot-verification of the lane's coverage manifest (suite-required assertion -> test mapping). A dishonest mapping adjudicates the milestone to capability-failure - scoring-only, non-retroactive; the harness applies the recharge.

verdict.description: not-checked is legal only when no milestone produced a suite pass to verify.

sampledAssertionIds.description: The suite-required assertion IDs whose mappings were sampled.

dishonestMilestones.description: Milestones whose mapping was found dishonest (each adjudicates to capability-failure).

defects.description: Severity-bucketed defects found beyond the checklist (O2's input). MATERIAL, for calibration and the grader-noise trigger, means blocker or major.

evidence.description: Evidence pointer: API transcript span, screenshot, receipt, or source location in the sanitized trace.

probeResults.description: Holdout-probe results by category (D3.5). Anchor probes appear with anchor=true and never bear on O3/O5 - they are published continuity diagnostics.

outcome.description: The preregistered never-built rule's outcome values, frozen with the probe set: a probe whose target behavior a failed milestone never built scores not-passed-never-built or excluded-with-note per that rule.

anchor.description: True for the category's unchanged cross-wave anchor (non-scored).

note.description: Required in substance when outcome is excluded-with-note.

oDimensionScores.description: Grader-scored outcome dimensions per applicability.json (weights O1:13 O2:7 O3:8 O4:9 O5:8). Non-applicable dimensions record null; the dual grader-abort outcome nulls all five regardless of applicability.

O5.description: O5 is band-mapped from the exact function's inputs (run record performanceProbes.o5Inputs), never interpolated.

bandRationale.description: Which first-match branch (order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75) fired and on which inputs.

timingRecords.description: Best-of-3 records for every timing-sensitive check judged under grader execution (duplicates the per-assertion bestOf3Ms where an assertion exists; standalone entries cover timing checks made during probing).

evidenceTracePath.description: Path to the sanitized evidence/action trace - the published artifact. Raw transcripts are never published (LLP 0197 redaction posture, LLP 0198 rule).

anchoredScore.description: A 0-100 dimension score with the rubric anchors cited (~30/~60/~90 interpolation). Null when the dimension is not applicable for this run.

anchorsCited.description: The anchor text interpolated against, quoted or referenced (e.g. 'between 60 and 90: M1-M4 solid, M5 patchy').

justification.description: Concrete evidence pointers supporting the placement.
